Class PortfolioController

java.lang.Object
com.andrei.stockportfoliobackend.controller.PortfolioController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/portfolio") public class PortfolioController extends Object
REST Controller for managing user portfolios. Exposes endpoints to view portfolio, get stock list, buy, and sell assets. All endpoints (except auth) are secured and require a valid JWT token.

    • addHolding

      @PostMapping public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> addHolding(@RequestBody AddHoldingRequest request, org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication)
      POST /api/portfolio Buys a stock (Adds a holding). If the stock is already owned, it recalculates the average price.
      Parameters:
      request - JSON body containing ticker, quantity, and optional price.
      authentication - The current user.
